# Deployment

This directory contains all deployment configuration and scripts for the MediaWiki instance.

## 📖 Comprehensive Documentation

For complete deployment documentation including system architecture diagrams, deployment workflows, and troubleshooting guides, see:

**[📋 Comprehensive Deployment Documentation](DEPLOYMENT.qmd)**

This document includes:

- System architecture with Mermaid diagrams
- Development, staging, and production workflows
- Database management and backup procedures
- CI/CD pipeline visualization
- Security and access control
- Monitoring and troubleshooting guides

## Files

- `DEPLOYMENT.qmd` - Comprehensive deployment documentation with Mermaid diagrams
- `Dockerfile` - Custom MediaWiki image with required extensions and configurations
- `docker-compose.dev.yml` - Docker Compose configuration for development environment
- `docker-compose.prod.yml` - Docker Compose configuration for production environment
- `LocalSettings.php` - MediaWiki configuration file
- `staging_LocalSettings.php` - MediaWiki configuration file for staging
- `example.env` - Environment variables template
- `backup_db.sh` - Database backup script
- `restore_db.sh` - Database restore script
- `setup_services_podman.sh` - Podman service setup script
- `sync_prod_to_staging.sh` - Production to staging synchronization script
- `Caddyfile` - Caddy reverse proxy configuration

## Quick Start

See the main [README.md](../README.md) for quick start instructions and the [comprehensive deployment documentation](DEPLOYMENT.qmd) for detailed deployment procedures.
